name: GSGAN Hierarchical Generation
definition: Output layer (toGaus): A set of 5 parallel linear layers synthesizing Gaussian parameters (α̂, q̂, µ̂, ŝ, ĉ) from intermediate feature xl. Color ĉ additionally takes camera parameter θ. Position µ̂ uses tanh activation. Scale difference ŝ uses -softplus activation.
summary: GSGAN Hierarchical Generation synthesizes 3D Gaussian splats via a neural network conditioned on pose, differing from standard methods by generating parameters rather than optimizing static point clouds.
